aboutDetails.en: I study conditional computation and reasoning in large models, with a focus on efficient training and inference. I also work on multimodal visual understanding and image analysis.
aboutDetails.zh: 我研究大模型的条件计算与推理，关注如何按需分配计算资源，提高训练和推理效率。我也研究多模态视觉理解与图像分析。

aboutDetails.en: I review for ICASSP, CVPR, and ICLR.
aboutDetails.zh: 我也为 ICASSP、CVPR 和 ICLR 等会议审稿。
